$comment: Hero cars, American, late 1960s to early 2000s. Same rule as the other two rosters: the
silhouette is exact, the lamps and bumpers are deliberately wrong, and no badge or script ever
appears. Muscle-era cars are carried almost entirely by PROPORTION — the ratio of bonnet to
cabin to tail, and the height of the shoulder line — so those are stated plainly and the
Period paint names are used freely; style.mjs picks the backdrop that will not destroy them, so
a lime green car goes on magenta without anyone having to remember to ask.

assets.subject: 1970s American long-nosed rear-drive V8 muscle coupe
assets.paint: hugger orange with two broad white stripes over the bonnet
silhouette: A very long low bonnet, a small cabin set far back, and a short high tail — roughly two thirds bonnet to one third cabin
A high shoulder line with the body swelling over each wheel arch
cues: a deep oval grille opening low in a forward-leaning nose with round lamps flanking it
a fastback roof falling in one long line into a short ducktail
two round tail lamps each side in a recessed black panel
slim chrome bumperettes rather than a full-width bumper
five-spoke alloy wheels with a deep dish
avoid: a short bonnet or a cabin set forward

assets.subject: 1980s American wedge-shaped rear-drive V8 sports hatchback coupe
silhouette: A hard flat wedge: a very low pointed nose rising in a straight line to a low flat roof, then a long glass hatch
An enormous single-piece wraparound rear window running almost to the tail
cues: pop-up headlamp panels shown CLOSED, so the nose is smooth and unbroken
a narrow slot grille low under the nose with no upper opening
a full-width slim tail lamp panel with fine horizontal louvre bars
body-coloured plastic bumpers blending flush into the nose and tail
wide flat-faced five-spoke alloy wheels
avoid: chrome bumpers or a chrome grille

assets.subject: 1970s American long-nosed fibreglass rear-drive V8 sports coupe
silhouette: Extreme coke-bottle shaping: the body pinches sharply inward at the waist between hugely swollen front and rear fenders
A very long pointed bonnet with raised fender crowns, a tiny cabin, and a chopped tail
cues: a long nose with a pointed prow and concealed headlamps shown closed and flush
raised humps arching over each wheel with a sharp crease along their tops
four round tail lamps in a rounded cut-off tail with chrome exhaust tips below
a removable roof panel with a body-coloured centre spine
five-spoke alloy wheels with a deep dish
avoid: exposed round headlamps standing on the nose

assets.subject: 1980s American flat-panelled rear-drive V8 sports coupe
silhouette: A flat low wedge of broad simple panels, much squarer and cleaner than its curvaceous predecessor
A long flat clamshell bonnet, a glass targa roof and a large curved glass hatch over a squared tail
cues: pop-up headlamp panels shown CLOSED, leaving a smooth flat nose with a slim lower slot
a straight crease running the full length of the body side at bumper height
four round tail lamps in a flat squared tail panel
a wide flat sill skirt along each side
wide flat-faced multi-spoke alloy wheels
avoid: coke-bottle waist pinching or swollen fenders

assets.subject: late-1990s American rounded rear-drive V8 sports coupe
silhouette: A smooth rounded wedge with soft full surfaces, a long bonnet and a large curved glass hatch
Gently swollen haunches and a high rounded tail
cues: slim fixed teardrop lamps under flush clear covers in a rounded nose
four round tail lamps, two each side, in a rounded tail
a quad exhaust exiting centrally under the tail
small round side vents behind the front wheels
five-spoke alloy wheels
avoid: flat square panels or hard folds

assets.subject: late-1980s American boxy rear-drive V8 sports hatchback coupe
silhouette: A boxy three-door fastback with straight flat sides, a squared nose and a long steeply raked glass hatch
An upright glasshouse on a flat-sided body with almost no curvature
cues: wide flush rectangular lamps either side of a slim slot in a flat sloping nose
a row of louvred slots moulded into the lower body sides ahead of each rear wheel
a three-bar vertical tail lamp cluster each side
a rubber lip spoiler across the top of the hatch
ten-hole flat-faced alloy wheels

assets.subject: 1969 American long-nosed rear-drive V8 muscle fastback
assets.paint: grabber blue with matte black bonnet stripes
silhouette: A long flat bonnet, a fastback roof falling in one unbroken line all the way to the tail, and a short tail
A high flat shoulder line with a deep sculpted scallop ahead of each rear wheel
cues: a wide rectangular grille with four round lamps set across it
a matte black rear window louvre laid over the backlight
three vertical tail lamp bars each side in a recessed black tail panel
a black rubber lip spoiler on the boot and a front chin spoiler
five-spoke chrome-rimmed wheels
materials: matte black trim, chrome, black tyres

assets.subject: 1969 American long rear-drive V8 muscle coupe
silhouette: Very long and slab-sided with a flat roof and a deeply recessed tunnel-backed rear window between two flying buttresses
A long flat bonnet and a high straight shoulder line running the whole length
cues: a full-width blacked-out grille with concealed headlamps shown closed
a deep scalloped indent pressed into each door
a full-width tail lamp panel divided into two long rectangles
a simple chrome bumper at each end
five-spoke chrome wheels with raised white-letter tyres
materials: chrome and matte black trim, black tyres
avoid: a fastback roof sloping to the tail

assets.subject: 1970 American wide rear-drive V8 muscle coupe
silhouette: Wide, low and squared with a long flat bonnet, a formal notchback roof and a short high tail
A straight shoulder line and flat slab sides with a subtle crease along them
cues: a wide rectangular grille split centrally with round lamps at the outer ends
a matte black bonnet with two raised scoops and chrome hold-down pins
a full-width slim tail lamp band
a black rubber lip spoiler on the boot
five-spoke chrome wheels with raised white-letter tyres

assets.subject: 1970 American short-tailed rear-drive V8 muscle coupe
silhouette: Short overhangs, a wide low stance and a compact formal roof set well back over a long bonnet
Flared arch lips standing slightly proud of flat body sides
cues: a wide grille with two round lamps at each outer end and a body-coloured centre bar
a raised bonnet scoop standing clear of the bonnet surface
four small rectangular tail lamps across a flat tail panel
black hockey-stick stripes sweeping along the front wings
chrome five-spoke wheels with raised white-letter tyres
materials: chrome and matte black trim, black tyres

assets.subject: 1970 American long rear-drive V8 muscle coupe
assets.paint: cranberry red with two broad white stripes over bonnet and boot
silhouette: A long formal notchback coupe with a flat roof, a long bonnet and a long flat boot
A straight high shoulder line with the body kicking up slightly over each rear wheel
cues: a blacked-out split grille with two round lamps at each outer end
twin raised bonnet power bulges running the length of the bonnet
two square tail lamps each side in a chrome-framed tail panel
full chrome bumpers front and rear
five-spoke chrome wheels with raised white-letter tyres

assets.subject: 1969 American long rear-drive V8 muscle coupe
assets.paint: carousel red-orange with contrasting stripe decals
silhouette: A long formal coupe with a flat roof, a long bonnet and a body-coloured nose with no chrome across it
A straight shoulder line and a kicked-up rear quarter
cues: a smooth body-coloured nose with two blacked-out grille slots and round lamps outboard
twin raised bonnet scoops set well forward
a tall rear wing standing clear of the boot lid on two short uprights
slim horizontal tail lamps in a chrome tail panel
chrome five-spoke wheels with raised white-letter tyres

assets.subject: 1970 American winged aerodynamic rear-drive V8 stock-car homologation coupe
silhouette: An ordinary long muscle coupe wearing two absurd aerodynamic additions: a long pointed nose cone and a towering rear wing
The nose extends far beyond where the body should end; the wing stands on two tall vertical struts
cues: a smooth pointed body-coloured nose cone with a slim lower intake and pop-up lamps shown closed
an enormous rear wing on two tall vertical uprights standing well above the boot
black vinyl roof covering and rear-facing scoops on the front wings
a full-width tail lamp panel beneath the wing
chrome wheels with raised white-letter tyres

assets.subject: late-1970s American long-nosed rear-drive V8 muscle coupe
silhouette: A very long low bonnet with a small cabin set far back and a short tail, the whole car low and wide
A fastback roof with a large wraparound rear window
cues: four square lamps set in pairs in a forward-leaning nose with two low grille slots
a rear-facing shaker scoop standing proud of the bonnet
flared arch extensions and a deep front air dam
a full-width slim tail lamp band with fine louvre bars
snowflake-pattern alloy wheels

assets.subject: 1987 American boxy blacked-out rear-drive turbo V6 muscle coupe
silhouette: A plain upright two-door saloon coupe, entirely square, with a formal notchback roof and a flat boot
A tall glasshouse and a straight flat shoulder line, utterly undecorated
cues: a plain rectangular grille with stacked square lamps each side, all in black
black arch flares and black vents cut into the front wings
a small black boot lip spoiler
slim rectangular tail lamps in a blacked-out panel
black mesh-pattern alloy wheels
materials: gloss black paint with matte black trim

assets.subject: late-1990s American wide front-engined V10 sports coupe
assets.paint: brilliant blue with two broad white stripes over the whole car
silhouette: A very long rounded bonnet, a tiny cabin set far back, and a short rounded tail — extremely wide and low
A double-bubble roof with two shallow domes over the seats
cues: large rounded lamp clusters under flush covers in a wide rounded nose
side exhaust pipes exiting through the sill just behind each front wheel
deep vents cut into the top of each front wing behind the wheel
a rounded glass hatch over a short high tail
wide five-spoke alloy wheels

assets.subject: early-1990s American wide front-engined V10 open roadster
silhouette: An open two-seater with no roof and no side windows: a very long rounded bonnet and a cut-off tail
Extremely wide and low with a cockpit set far back
cues: large rounded lamp clusters under flush covers in a wide rounded nose
side exhaust pipes exiting through the sill behind each front wheel
a low wraparound windscreen with no frame above it
two humps behind the seats and a plain cut-off tail
wide five-spoke alloy wheels

assets.subject: mid-1980s American small mid-engined two-seat sports coupe
silhouette: A small low wedge with a short flat nose, a cabin set forward and a fastback tail over a mid-mounted engine
Flat plastic body panels with visible straight shut lines
cues: pop-up headlamp panels shown CLOSED, so the flat nose is smooth
scooped air intakes just ahead of each rear wheel
a fastback rear window flowing into a short ducktail
black plastic bumpers and sill mouldings wrapping the body
flat-faced multi-spoke alloy wheels

assets.subject: early-1980s American stainless-steel mid-engined wedge coupe

silhouette: A flat folded wedge of straight planes with a low chisel nose rising to a flat roof and a squared tail
A wide low body with black louvres over the rear deck
cues: two rectangular lamps each side set flush in the flat nose above a slim black bumper
upward-hinging gullwing doors, shown closed
black slatted louvres laid over the rear window and engine deck
a straight black rubbing strip running the length of each body side
flat-faced multi-spoke alloy wheels

assets.subject: 1960s British-American tiny open two-seat V8 roadster
assets.paint: dark blue with two broad white stripes over nose, body and tail
silhouette: A tiny open roadster of almost nothing but fenders: a short rounded nose, an open cockpit and a stubby rounded tail
Hugely bulged wheel arches on all four corners over a very narrow body
cues: a small oval mouth low in the nose with round lamps set into the fender tops
side exhaust pipes running along the sill below each door
a low wraparound windscreen with a roll bar behind the seats
a filler cap standing proud on the rear deck
chrome knock-off centre-lock wire or five-spoke wheels

assets.subject: 1960s American-British extremely low mid-engined V8 endurance racing coupe

silhouette: Astonishingly low — barely higher than its own wheels — with a rounded low nose and a long flat engine deck
A tiny bubble cabin set forward with doors cutting up into the roof

a wide low mouth across the nose with two round brake ducts beside it
black slatted louvres over the rear engine deck
a chopped vertical tail with a lip spoiler and exhausts beneath
deep-dished five-spoke magnesium wheels, fatter at the rear

a front engine with a long bonnet

assets.subject: early-1990s American extreme wedge mid-engined twin-turbo supercar

large angular intakes cut into each flank ahead of the rear wheels
black slatted louvres over the rear deck and a full-width tail lamp panel
a squared roof scoop standing above the cabin

assets.subject: late-1960s American short two-seat rear-drive V8 muscle coupe

a raised bonnet with two long functional scoops

two round fog lamps set low in the front bumper
three vertical tail lamp bars each side, set in a rounded tail
a small rear spoiler on the boot lid
five-spoke alloy wheels
